title: Prefixes
description: Adds a Terraria style prefix / reforge system.
body:
![A Minecraft character holding two swords of different sizes in their hands, with the word "PREFIXES" in front of them](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/71525963f5f311fafe59e57610ac81267539a2da_0.webp)

# Prefixes for Every Weapon and Tool
Simple prefix system/reforging table based on the system from Terraria, all using vanilla attributes. Includes 20+ prefixes with a built in tier system built on the vanilla rarity system, with added custom sound effects for each prefix (just for fun). Should support modded weapons and tools natively, but also supports manual item adding via custom tags. Feel free to add your own!

[prefixes.weapons](https://github.com/Badtz13/prefixes/blob/main/src/main/resources/data/prefixes/tags/item/weapons.json)

[prefixes.tools](https://github.com/Badtz13/prefixes/blob/main/src/main/resources/data/prefixes/tags/item/tools.json)


## Example:
![A gif showing an example of reforging, displaying that it costs 1 experience point per reforge. I was very unlucky here.](https://files.catbox.moe/5oyfwr.gif)

Interact with the reforging table while holding a tool or weapon to use it. Every time you reforge something, it uses exactly one (1) level. You can reforge an item as many times as you want, and will get something random every time. Maybe keep it away from your crafting table and furnace to avoid accidentally making your pickaxe sluggish.

## Customizability:
The prefixes are also data driven, and can be added or custimized to your liking. For defaults, see [here.](https://github.com/Badtz13/prefixes/tree/main/src/main/resources/data/prefixes/tools) and the matching [weapons ](https://github.com/Badtz13/prefixes/tree/main/src/main/resources/data/prefixes/tools) prefixes.
